solution.title: Intune Wi-Fi Profile Deployment & Management (Windows, iOS & Android)

products.name: Intune Wi-Fi Profile Deployment & Management (Windows, iOS & Android) — Commercial
products.short_description: Push corporate Wi-Fi to Windows, iOS/iPadOS, and Android Enterprise from Intune — the right SSID, security type, and proxy on every device, with no user setup. Self-guided, click-by-click, pilot-first, and a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Every device joins corporate Wi-Fi automatically — on all three platforms

Handing users an SSID and a password is slow, inconsistent, and leaks a shared key onto every device. And the proxy field is a minefield — one URL pasted where a host belongs and the whole network breaks. This solution deploys Wi-Fi configuration profiles from Microsoft Intune to Windows, iOS/iPadOS, and Android Enterprise, so each device connects on its own with the correct network name, security type, and proxy — authored once per platform, piloted, then expanded to the fleet.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths for each platform; every object you create is named (e.g. WIFIMGT - Corp WiFi - Windows - Pilot) and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; comparable consulting runs ~$1,500–$3,000/day. Reusable on every rollout and every new SSID.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with three explicit pass/fail gates: profile deployed, device auto-joins the SSID, proxy applied correctly.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what a Wi-Fi profile carries (SSID, security type, proxy), the cross-platform delivery model, and where the 802.1X certificate build is deferred to the companion Cisco ISE product.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (network facts, the proxy decision, roles, per-platform enrollment, Apple APNs, managed Google Play, the certificate/RADIUS chain for enterprise networks, pilot/production groups, Government cloud) with how to verify and implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — click-by-click deployment on Windows, iOS/iPadOS, and Android Enterprise (corporate-owned and BYOD work profile), in order, with exact field labels — including the proxy done right per platform (manual = host + port; automatic = PAC URL).
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — tenant preflight, export existing Wi-Fi profiles + assignments, validate which devices received the profile, a fleet deployment-state report, and guarded remediation of missing assignments (default -WhatIf). All cloud-aware for Commercial and US Government tenants.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices for security-type choice, proxy discipline, and safe change management.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next SSID, the next platform, and the next project.

The bottom line

Every managed device on every platform joins corporate Wi-Fi automatically and correctly — profiles delivered from Intune, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Complete Solution (ZIP) — the full package in one download: the Implementation Guide as a Word document and PDF (solution overview, requirements, click-by-click implementation for all three platforms, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices), plus all 5 PowerShell scripts:
    • WIFIMGT-Preflight.ps1 — read-only tenant readiness check (SDK, Graph scopes, Apple APNs, Android Enterprise binding, pilot group)
    • WIFIMGT-Get-WifiProfiles.ps1 — export existing Wi-Fi profiles across platforms with their assignments
    • WIFIMGT-Validate-Assignment.ps1 — report which groups/devices received the named Wi-Fi profiles
    • WIFIMGT-Report-Connectivity.ps1 — fleet Wi-Fi profile deployment-state (Succeeded / Error / Conflict)
    • WIFIMGT-Remediation.ps1 — guarded fix for missing pilot/production group assignments (default -WhatIf)

Delivered as a single ZIP containing the Word document, the PDF, and all PowerShell scripts — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
